cands.name: Amber M. Baker
cands.bio: Democrat representing N.C. House District 72 (Winston-Salem) since January 2021. Former principal of Kimberley Park School and principal consultant with Beyond Expectations Consultants. Holds a B.S. from Winston-Salem State University and an M.A. and Ph.D. from Ohio State University.

endorsements.text: Planned Parenthood Votes! South Atlantic and Vote Mama (listed in her 2024 Ballotpedia survey).
Sierra Club North Carolina (2026 endorsement listed on Ballotpedia), along with the voter-guide recommendations of Athena Stationery Ballot Party and NC Public School Champions.

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was raised or when she moved to North Carolina. We found no documented stances or actions on data centers, development and growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration and H-1B, policing, or gun laws. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. The Ballotpedia list of bills she sponsored did not display, so we did not report any of her legislation. No controversies appeared in the pages we read.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.
score.why_money: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Member of the N.C. House since 2021 (re-elected 2022, 2024 and 2026) and Appropriations Committee vice chair in 2023-24; before that, a Winston-Salem school principal for more than a decade and an education consultant.
qual.why: Nearly five years of prior legislative service plus a long career managing a school put her in the high range; committee roles were not counted toward the score.
qual.label: Nearly five years of prior legislative service plus a long career managing a school put her in the high range; committee roles were not counted toward the score.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said she would continue to fight for wage increases for certified and classified school employees and for full funding of Leandro; she did not address vouchers or charters.

pro-life.evidence: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said her focus would include fighting for reproductive rights and healthcare for women.
